title: QhoD — Quellen zur habsburgisch-osmanischen Diplomatie (Digital Scholarly Edition of Habsburg-Ottoman Diplomatic Sources 1500-1918) — edition-data release 2.0
notes: QhoD is the born-digital critical edition of Habsburg-Ottoman diplomatic sources (diplomatic correspondence, instructions, minutes...), TEI encoded, CC BY 4.0, published via qhod.net (verified live) with TEI/image data released on GitHub (QHOD/qhod-edition-data) and Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.14449603, release 2.0 by Stephan Kurz, verified live) — exactly the RQ source. RQ's 219 texts (1570-1600 era) come from that Zenodo/GitHub TEI edition-data bundle (Habsburg-Ottoman diplomatic texts in Latin etc.). Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, including retained duplicates; harvested subset).
institution: QhoD project (PI Arno Strohmeyer), Institute for Habsburg and Balkan Studies (IHB), Austrian Academy of Sciences (OEAW); technical editor Stephan Kurz; TEI publishing via ACDH-CH/ZIM Graz (GAMS)
